_note: docs/v7/phase1-nft-pooled.md §1-§2: the five launch collections (docs/v7/phase1-nft.md §9 D1) as DeployStack takes them: ETCH_STACK_KIND=nft with ETCH_NFT_COLLECTIONS / _NAMES / _SYMBOLS / _SLUGS and ETCH_NFT_NORMAL_RAISES / _EARLY_RAISES / _CONV_BPS_LIST / _RESERVE_BPS_LIST as comma lists in this order; scripts/golive-dryrun.sh builds them from this file. Unnamed values take the frog stack's defaults: normalRaise 5 ETH, earlyRaise 8 ETH, earlyUntilEth 2 ETH, maxRaise 30 ETH, convBps 300, reserveBps 2500. BAYC is J1 as the operator decided it on 2026-09-27: 10 ETH (normal = early, the CurveFactory ceiling), convBps 1000, reserveBps 0. At the 6.79 floor one graduation converts 1.137 units, so it buys one ape alone; that holds while the floor at its graduation is at most 7.35 ETH (+8.26 %; above it BAYC pools two graduations per ape), and a graduation at 6.79 is still advanced and bought after a floor rise to 7.35 ETH (+8.32 %, the canister's advance gate: Relay's estimated 0.5 %, the floor + 1 % and 0.003 ETH). So any rise of up to 8.26 % from 6.79, before or after the graduation, still buys one ape with one graduation. convBps 1000 is where those two edges meet (the exact optimum at 6.79 is 997, +8.29 %).
_canister: eth_nft.collections: max_purchase_wei is each collection's maxPurchaseWei (milady 2 ETH, azuki 2 ETH, mayc 2 ETH, pudgypenguins 4 ETH, bayc 8 ETH; at BAYC's convBps 1000 8 ETH covers the item cap 1.10 x 6.79 = 7.47 and a buy at the +8.26 % edge (7.35 x 1.05 = 7.72); a graduation at the 7.35 edge has an item cap of 8.09, and the canister advances min(item cap, 8 ETH) (floorsink::view), which still reaches Ethereum covering a floor up to 7.88); max_premium_bps 500 each. script/golive-check.sh --launch holds the factory targets, the module conversion and reserve, and (with --canister) max_purchase_wei against this file (audit 2026-09-27-nft round 2, D2-L-5)
_custody: J7, decided by the operator 2026-09-27 (docs/v7/phase1-nft-pooled.md §6): each Ethereum collection's stage-0 custody cap is custodyWei = 15 ETH (one item up to 15 ETH) and custodyItems = what fits 15 ETH at its floor of 2026-09-27 (15 / floor, rounded down: Milady 0.93 → 16, Azuki 0.67 → 22, MAYC 0.8735 → 17, Pudgy 3.353 → 4, BAYC 6.79 → 2), and there is no canister-wide total: the install's custody_caps names the global caps as the sum of the collections' (48 items at step 1 of `stages`, 61 after step 3; 75 ETH), which never binds before theirs (review round 7, A7-I-2) (custodycap.rs FIRST_EVM_*, first_global). A deposit counts at the module's accepted floor (review round 3 A3-L-4). Because holders must be able to take every item out within the timelock's 72 h less a day (outflow::exit_fits), 22 items need 11 deliveries a day per collection: the install's outflow_limits are per_collection_items 12 and global_items 24 (x4 stage 0, the most an install may start at), per_collection_mints 3, global_mints 6, global_value_wei 25 ETH (H3, the operator 2026-09-27: 10 ETH before), trip_factor 3. script/golive-check.sh --launch holds custodyItems and custodyWei per collection against the canister's custody_caps(), and that the total never binds.
_outflow: The install's outflow_limits as _custody states them (the operator, 2026-09-27; unchanged), as data so script/golive-check.sh --launch holds them (review round 4, A4-I-2) and checks the exit rule against the whole custody (A4-L-1): every item of every collection must be able to leave within the timelock's 72 h less a day. At these limits the custodyItems above (step 1 of the operator's option (c): 48 in all) fit exactly (48 can leave at 24 a day within the two usable days); J7's 61 would not, which is why they come only at step 3, after step 2 raises global_items to 31 (`stages`, fixes-round5.md §6; review round 6 A6-L-1 corrected this text, which still said 61). openseaSlug / coingeckoId are the D8 references of deployments/launch/monitor-nft.json, held against it by collection (A3-L-3).
_stage: which step of `stages` the canister is at: golive-check --launch holds the canister to this step's numbers (--stage overrides it for a step's own read)

stages.name: install
stages._when: the launch install (the pre-handover reinstall, or the first timelocked upgrade carrying this build): 48 items at 12 / 24 a day

stages.name: outflow raise
stages._when: proposed only after step 1 has executed and the handover is done; runs 72 h later. Its argument differs from step 1's in outflow_limits.global_items alone (golive-check --proposal --stage 2). Any other upgrade of the buyer executed in those 72 h makes it stale: queue it again

stages.name: caps back to J7
stages._when: after two clean weeks at step 2: its argument differs from step 2's in custody_caps alone, the item counts J7's 61 with the global the sum (golive-check --proposal --stage 3)

_monitor: deployments/launch/monitor-nft.json: the launch monitor configuration's Ethereum part (D8 references per collection, the no-good-post poster pause), held by script/golive-check.sh --monitor-config
